title: Hearty Tunisian Split Peas Pilaf
description: A lazy Sunday dish featuring split peas and crispy fried onions, this Tunisian pilaf is a satisfying and flavorful meal, jain-friendly and perfect for a relaxing day at home.
instructions: Rinse the split peas and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Drain and set the peas aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and fry until crispy and golden brown.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and pepper to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the rice to the pan and stir to combine with the spices and onions.
Add the soaked split peas and 4 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the peas and rice are tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
